card.name: Quantities in old-time trade and pay
card.fires_on: Words and numbers in a quantity phrase inside a historical passage about trade, wages or barter, such as "barrels of", "a single", "twelve" or "three thousand" before old goods or coins.

modes.label: Goods bartered or shipped
modes.description: Quantity words before traded goods in old trade accounts.

modes.label: Pay in old currency
modes.description: Number words before coins such as florins or thalers in a historical salary.

modes.label: Exchange for goods
modes.description: Words in a barter phrase, such as "exchange of a single knife".

card.writes: It favors old-world trade and craft nouns such as inn, tavern, craftsman and wagon, and disfavors modern items such as car, phone and radio.
card.plain: It marks counts and amounts in pre-modern trade and pay, and nudges the text toward old-world nouns rather than modern machines.
